小心，即通常的程序是：在白天任何时间离开家之前，他的五名保镖会先出去，清除附近徘徊的所有行人。其次，在离家之前，他会打电话给办公室，通知其直属下属他即将离开，预计十到十五分钟内到达，这样办公室的武装警卫就会在他到达之前在办公室外占据位置；同样的程序也适用于他回家时，即办公室警卫会下到九江路，清除附近的闲杂人员，并通过电话通知他家他正在返回，以便在那一端安排接应。事实上，他的预防措施做得非常到位，甚至每天指示他的司机，无论何时两人一同外出，如果汽车遇到红灯，绝不要停车，而是采取另一种替代方案，左转进入相关的横向道路。
鉴于投诉人采取了这些预防措施，以及他提到最近只有在极其必要的情况下才去办公室，本人对其进行了询问，

辆车的距离。报案人称，经过一家巧克力店后，他突然听到一声枪响，同时有什么东西击中了他所坐位置旁边的车身侧面。意识到自己是射击目标后，他伏倒在车地板上，同时指示司机加速驶往中央巡捕房。司机照办了，但在此之前，汽车的左后侧几乎已被子弹打穿，如果汽车不是防弹的，这些子弹绝大多数肯定会导致他受伤，甚至死亡。报案人及与其一同离家的其他同车人员均否认看到任何企图行刺者，另一辆车上的四名保镖也是如此，他们仅表示听到了枪声，但在抵达中央巡捕房场地并看到车上的弹孔之前，并不知道枪声是冲着他们的主人去的。在回答第二个问题时，报案人表示他不怀疑任何私人仆人，所有仆人都已跟随家族多年，不过为了澄清这一点，他打电话回家，询问家人在他离

parture for the office any of the servants had been
seen to use the phone, and in reply received a
negative answer, his family informing him that the
only call since his departure had been from himself
informing them of his homecoming. Regarding the last
and final query complainant stated that there was
every possibility of someone in the office having
given him away, inasmuch that at least 50% of his
present staff were ex-employees of the Tax Bureau
previously operated under the Nationalist Government
and that the man named Koo Te Tsong 顾德中 who
had embezzled the sum of $40,000.00 had been one
of this clique, he having been introduced into
the Bureau a few months ago by an ex-member of the
Nationalist Government Tax Bureau.

    In view of the aforegoing and on the strength
of complainant's suspicions regarding certain members
of his staff, the following theory was formed and
explained to complainant for his view on the matter.

    Taking into consideration that he had been
the receipt of numerous threatening letters and
coupled with the fact that he is the man who reorganised
the Consolidated Tax Bureau under the "Reformed Govern-
ment," there remains little doubt that his assassination
must have been premeditated for some time past.

开家去办公室后，是否看到有任何仆人使用电话，得到的答复是否定的，家人告诉他，自他离开后唯一的电话是他自己打回来的，告知他们他将回家。关于最后一个问题，报案人表示，办公室里有人出卖他的可能性极大，因为他目前的职员中至少有50%是前国民政府税务局的前雇员，而侵吞40,000.00美元的顾德中 (Koo Te Tsong) 曾是这一派系的一员，他是几个月前由一名前国民政府税务局成员介绍进入该局的。

鉴于上述情况，并根据报案人对某些职员的怀疑，形成了以下推论，并向报案人解释以征求其意见。

考虑到他收到过许多恐吓信，再加上他是“维新政府”下重组联合税务局的人，毫无疑问，对他的暗杀预谋已久。

but with him exercising the precautions that he has
adopted of late, it would be well nigh impossible for
anyone to know of his movements, hence in order to
facilitate his assassination what plan would have
been better than to stage this offence of embezzlement,
knowing full well that same would result in his attend-
ing office at a certain time and date, which in ordinary

as already stated he only did on very rare occasions.
Again consideration must be given to the fact that the

inasmuch that the "Collecting Department" of the Tax
Bureau usually hand their collections of monies to
the "Accounting Department" twice daily, i.e. 12 noon
and 5 p.m. and the man Koo Sz Tsoong who is an employee
of the latter Department had gone to collect monies
at 11 a.m. and when he did not return at 2 p.m. the
suspicions were aroused, hence anyone working in
conjunction with him would have known the complainant
could not attend the office until afternoon.

Complainant on learning this theory immediately
added to its value by stating that had it not been
for this case happening he would never have attended

My name is Zau Shih Cheun, aged 32 years, native of
Chekiang and resident at No. 39 Nanyang Road. At present I
am employed as the managing director of the Consolidated Tax
Bureau of the Kiangsu, Anhwei and Chekiang Provinces.
    In the year 1925 I joined the Ministry of Finance and
remained in this position until 1936 when I took up a postion
with the Tobacco Tax Bureau in Fokien Province. I remained
with this tax bureau until July 1937 when I resigned. At
this time I was also Chairman of the Anhwei Tatung Coal Cor-
poration, being a shareholder in the same concern.
    About November 1937 with the consent of the Japanese
Military Authorities I organized the Consolidated Tax
Bureau operating in the Anhwei Chekiang and Kiangsu provinces,
with my head offices at No. 230 Kiukiang Road, several branch
offices are located in the International Settlement but these
have their own staffs to look after the work, and I seldom
visit them.
    All monies collected from taxes are, after expenses
have been deducted deposited in the Mercantile Bank of India
Australia and China.
    During the past five months I have received a number of
threatening letters, some of which have contained demands
for money and others have threatened my life, the receipt of
these letters caused me to take extraordinary precautions and
also employ body-guards, and deterred me from attending the
office or any other place outside my home unless absolutely
necessary.
pages.zh:
鄒式軍 (ZAU SHIH CHUEN)
浙江                                警探 Rhodes.
                                            Chu
总部 中央巡捕房        1938年10月17日            副督察长 / Shou Ling.

我叫邹式军 (Zau Shih Cheun)，32岁，浙江人，现住南阳路39号。目前我担任江苏、安徽和浙江三省联合税务局的总经理。
    1925年，我加入财政部，并在此职位上工作至1936年，当时我在福建省烟草税务局任职。我在该税务局工作至1937年7月辞职。当时我还担任安徽大通煤矿公司的董事长，并在该公司持有股份。
    1937年11月左右，经日本军方当局同意，我组织了在安徽、浙江和江苏三省运营的联合税务局，总局设在九江路230号，国际租界内设有几个分局，但这些分局有自己的工作人员处理工作，我很少去视察。
    所有征收的税款在扣除费用后，均存入印度澳洲中华汇理银行。
    在过去五个月里，我收到多封恐吓信，其中一些索要钱财，另一些则威胁我的生命，收到这些信件使我采取了非凡的预防措施，并雇佣了保镖，这也阻止了我前往办公室或家以外的任何其他地方，除非绝对必要。

pages.en:
- 2 -

Today I received a telephone message from the office
requesting that I attend at once in connection with the
embezzlement of $40,000. by one of the office staff.
After explaining to the office that I would attend immediately
and asking them to exercise the usual precautions as was
customary, I left my home in my car S.M.C. Licence No.10248
accompanied by my valet named Tu Hai Sing (涂海山) chauffeur
Tseu Yoong Fah (趙云發) and a body guard Wong Kung Zeng
(王功成), the valet and myself were occupying the rear
seat of the car. Following directly behind in another car
was four of my armed body-guards, we arrived at the office
at Kiukiang Road at about 3.10 p.m. and parked both cars
in the lane at the rear of the building.

I remained in the office until about 5.15 p.m. when
having completed my business I phoned my home and informed
them that I was about to start, accompanied by the same people
who had come with me to the office I left the lane and entered
Kiukiang Road, my car in front closely followed by my body-
guards. I instructed the driver to drive straight home and
since he had previously received instructions to pick roads
where there appeared to be less chance of being obstructed
or where he could always take a left hand turn at corners
and thus avoid being held stationary at red traffic lights, he
turned East along Kiukiang Road, thence North along Kiangse
Road and west into Nanking Road.

Arriving at a point opposite the Hardoon building on
Nanking Road the car was proceeding slowly in the line of
pages.zh:
- 2 -

今天我接到办公室的电话，要求我立即前往，处理一名办公室职员侵吞40,000美元一事。在向办公室解释我将立即前往，并要求他们像往常一样采取通常的预防措施后，我乘坐牌照号为 S.M.C. 10248 的私家车离开家，随行人员有名为涂海山 (Tu Hai Sing) 的男仆、司机赵云发 (Tseu Yoong Fah) 和保镖王功成 (Wong Kung Zeng)，男仆和我坐在汽车后座。另一辆车载着我的四名武装保镖直接跟在后面，我们于下午3点10分左右抵达九江路的办公室，并将两辆车都停在建筑物后方的弄堂里。

我在办公室停留至下午5点15分左右，办完公事后，我打电话回家，告知他们我即将出发，随同前来办公室的同一批人离开弄堂，进入九江路，我的车在前，保镖紧随其后。我指示司机直接开车回家，由于他此前已接到指示，要选择那些看似较少受阻或在路口总能左转从而避免在红灯前静止等待的道路，他沿九江路向东行驶，然后沿江西路向北行驶，再向西转入南京路。

当到达南京路上哈同大楼对面的一点时，汽车在

pages.en:
- 3 -
traffic between the tramisland and the south side curb,
when I heard the sound of pistol shots and also heard and
felt them striking the near side of my car. I at once
dropped to the floor of the car and ordered the chauffeur
to drive to the nearest Police Station, the shooting stopped
for a second but resumed again when we reached the corner
of Nanking and Honan Roads corner, and also after having
turned the corner into Honan Road. In all I think at least
about a dozen shots were fired at a rapid pace. During the sh
ting I did not once catch sight of the gunmen.

The car conveying the bodyguards had, when turning
from Kiangse Road into Nanking Road got about four or
five cars behind and thus were unable to be of assistance
to me.

This is my true statement.

SIGNED : ZAU SHIK CHUEN.
pages.zh:
- 3 -
电车岛和南侧路缘之间的车流中缓慢行驶，这时我听到手枪射击声，同时也听到并感觉到子弹击中了我汽车的近侧。我立即伏倒在车地板上，命令司机驶往最近的警察局，射击停止了一秒钟，但当我们到达南京路和河南路路口，以及转过拐角进入河南路后，射击又恢复了。总的来说，我认为至少快速发射了十几发子弹。在射击期间，我一次也没有看到枪手的身影。

运送保镖的汽车在从江西路转入南京路时，落后了大约四到五辆车，因此无法为我提供援助。

这是我的真实陈述。

签名：邹式军 (ZAU SHIK CHUEN).

pages.en:
WONG TOONG HWEI ( 王東輝 )
Hopei // C.D.S. 273.
C.B.HoQ. (CeB) 17.10.38 HSU.

My name is Wong Toong Hwei, age 35, native of Hopei,
married/bodyguard, employed at No. 39 Nanyang Road.
Before the recent Shanghai hostilities I was in the
capacity of a C.P.C. of the Kwantso Police.
In March this year through the introduction of my friend
one named Du Hai San, I procured a position as a bodyguard
of Mr. Zam, Chief of the Consolidated Tax Bureau of Chekiang,
Anhwei and Kiangsu Provinces, located at No. 230 Kiukiang
Road. Du Hai San himself is also employed by Mr. Zam
as the latter's valet.
At 3.30 p.m. on 17.10.38 my master left home for his
office in m/Car Lic. No. 10248, and he was guarded by me
together with two others namely : - (1) Chen Ming Dzien,
& (2) Tsang Yuen Deng. We three took another m/car Lic.
No. 10241 which followed the car, occupied by our master.
At 5.30 p.m. same date my master came out of his office
and boarded the same m/car, returning to his home. My
master's car was proceeding before the one occupied by
us. Our master's car proceeded east along Kiukiang Road,
turned north into Kiangse Road and then turned west into
Nanking Road. On arrival of our master's car at Honan
Road corner our car was separated from our master's by
4 or 5 other m/cars due to the rush hour after offices.
In this moment we heard firing of shots when our chauffeur
immediately drove on as fast as possible to see our master's
car turn south into Honan Road and stopped at the Central
Police Station, where I found about 16 holes caused by bullets
pages.zh:
王東輝 (WONG TOONG HWEI)
河北 // C.D.S. 273.
中央捕房总部 (CeB) 1938年10月17日 HSU。

本人姓名王东辉，年龄35岁，籍贯河北，已婚/保镖，受雇于南阳路39号。
在最近的上海战事之前，我曾担任关渡警察（Kwantso Police）的巡长（C.P.C.）。
今年三月，经一位名叫杜海山的朋友介绍，我谋得浙江、安徽及江苏三省统税局局长Zam先生（音译）的保镖一职，该局位于九江路230号。杜海山本人也受雇于Zam先生，担任其贴身男仆。
1938年10月17日下午3时30分，我的主人乘坐牌照号为10248的机动车离家前往办公室，由我以及另外两人随行护卫，即：(1) 陈明先 (Chen Ming Dzien)，及 (2) 张荣棠 (Tsang Yuen Deng)。我们三人乘坐另一辆牌照号为10241的机动车，跟随载有我们主人的车辆。
同日下午5时30分，我的主人走出办公室，登上同一辆机动车，返回家中。我们主人的车行驶在我们所乘车辆的前面。主人的车沿九江路向东行驶，转入江西路向北，随后转入南京路向西。当主人的车到达河南路口时，由于下班高峰时段，我们的车与主人的车之间隔了四五辆其他机动车。
就在此刻，我们听到枪声，我们的司机立即尽可能快地驾车前行，只见我们主人的车转入河南路向南，并停在中央捕房，在那里我发现我们主人的车上有约16个弹孔

pages.en:
- 2 -

in our master's car. From this I became to understand that
our master's car had been attacked. I heard the firing
of shots, but did not see the attackers.
The above is my true statement.

SIGNED : WONG TOONG HWEI.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

由此我得知我们主人的车遭到了袭击。我听到了枪声，但未看到袭击者。
以上是我的真实陈述。

签署：王东辉。

pages.en:
ZAU YOONG FAH (赵荣发)

Nanking
C.B.Ho.Q. (C.S)    17.10.38    // D.S.I. Wong Foh Sung.
                                translated
                                ///////// HSU.

My name is Zau Yoong Fah, age 28, native of Nanking,
m/Chauffeur, (S.M.C.permit No. 14591) driving M/Car, Lic.
No. 10248, employed and residing at No. 39 Nanyang Road.

At 5.25 p.m. on 17.10.38 I drove a m/car which conveyed
my master, from the latter's office at No. 230 Kiujiang Road,
towards east to Kiangse Road, turned north into Kiangse Road,
and then turned west into Nanking Road. On reaching outside
the Ha-Doong Building, Nanking Road I heard some shots being
fired at our m/car from left side and subsequently heard
a burst of over 10 shots, whereupon I, tooting the horn,
drove the m/car towards Honan Road, and then speedily
steered it south to Hankow Road. On seeing a traffic
C.P.C. [污损] - Hankow Roads, allow east to west bound
traffic, I immediately turned east into Kiangse Road,
and then turned south & west into Foochow Road direct to Central
Police Station where a report of the occurrence was made.
In first instance I intended to turn south into Honan Road
and then direct to Central Police Station. By doing so it
would be more safe than driving towards west which might
cause likely danger if the attackers approached from
behind in another m/car. During the confusion I vaguely
saw the attacker who fired shots at our car from left side
wearing dark green foreign suits jacket, round face.
I heard the burst of shots start from outside the Ha-
Doong Building and when I turned south into Honan Road
I was unable to hear same. In my haste driving of my
car from the dangerous zone I accidentally knocked down
pages.zh:
赵荣发 (ZAU YOONG FAH)

南京
中央捕房总部 (C.S)    1938年10月17日    // 副督察黄福松 (D.S.I. Wong Foh Sung)。
                                翻译
                                ///////// HSU。

本人姓名赵荣发，年龄28岁，籍贯南京，机动车司机，（工部局执照编号14591），驾驶牌照号为10248的机动车，受雇并居住于南阳路39号。

1938年10月17日下午5时25分，我驾驶一辆载有我家主人的机动车，从后者位于九江路230号的办公室出发，向东行驶至江西路，转入江西路向北，随后转入南京路向西。当到达南京路哈同大楼（Ha-Doong Building）外时，我听到左侧有人向我们的机动车开枪，随后听到一连串超过10发的枪声，于是我按响喇叭，将车驶向河南路，然后迅速转向南驶入汉口路。看到一名交通巡长 [污损] - 汉口路，允许东西向交通通行，我立即向东转入江西路，然后向南并直接向西转入福州路，直达中央捕房报告此事。
起初我打算向南转入河南路，然后直接前往中央捕房。这样做比向西行驶更安全，因为如果袭击者乘坐另一辆机动车从后方接近，向西行驶可能会带来危险。在混乱中，我模糊地看到从左侧向我们车开枪的袭击者，身穿深绿色西式外套，圆脸。
我听到枪声始于哈同大楼外，当我向南转入河南路时，已听不到枪声。在我匆忙驾车逃离危险区域时，我不慎撞倒了一名

pages.en:
- 2 -

a woman of about 30 years old, on Hankow - Kiangse Roads,
when I turned our car south into Kiangse Road. I at once
applied brakes, but my master instructed me to drive on
speedily in order to save further risk. On complying with
my master's order I started motor again when I saw the female
get up from the ground.

SIGNED : ZAU YOONG FAH.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

约30岁的妇女，地点在汉口路与江西路路口，当时我正将车向南转入江西路。我立即刹车，但我的主人指示我继续快速行驶，以避免进一步的风险。遵照主人的命令，我重新发动汽车，此时我看到那名女子从地上站了起来。

签署：赵荣发。

pages.en:
WONG KOONG ZUNG (王功成)
Hopei
C.B.H.Q. (C.S)    17.10.38    // D.G.I. Wong Foh Sung.
                                translated
                                //////    HSU.

My name is Wong Koong Zung, age 33, native of Hopei,
employed and residing at No. 39 Nanyang Road, the home
of my master's named Zen, where I have been employed as
a bodyguard for one year.
At about 5.20 p.m. on 17.10.38 we left No. 230 Kiukiang
Road in m/cars, which were driven east to Kiangse Road,
turned north to Nanking and then turned west into Nanking
Road. On arrival at a point outside the Ha-Doong Building
somebody on the left side of the car fired shots at our
master's car. I immediately told the chauffeur not to
be afraid but to drive ahead. At the same time I asked
my master to lie down in the car and not to fear, whilst
I drew out my pistol and lay down the glass on the left
side of the car, ready for action. However my master
instructed me not to fire any shots as there were too
many pedestrians on the road at the time. Besides, he
ordered the chauffeur to speed our m/car to a nearest
Police Station. Thereupon I pulled up the glass when
I still heard about 20 shots. The car in which we were
the occupants was immediately driven into Henan Road.
Owing to the big number of pedestrians on the roadway
at the time of shooting I could not see the men who
made the attack on our car.
This is a truth.

SIGNED : WONG KOONG ZUNG.
pages.zh:
王功成 (WONG KOONG ZUNG)
河北
中央捕房总部 (C.S)    1938年10月17日    // 总督察黄福松 (D.G.I. Wong Foh Sung)。
                                翻译
                                //////    HSU。

本人姓名王功成，年龄33岁，籍贯河北，受雇并居住于南阳路39号，即我主人Zen（音译）的住所，我在此担任保镖已有一年。
1938年10月17日下午5时20分左右，我们乘坐机动车离开九江路230号，车辆向东行驶至江西路，转入南京路向北，随后转入南京路向西。当到达哈同大楼外某处时，有人从车辆左侧向我主人的车开枪。我立即告诉司机不要害怕，继续向前开。同时，我请主人在车内趴下，不要恐惧，而我则拔出手枪，放下车窗左侧的玻璃，准备行动。然而，主人指示我不要开枪，因为当时路上行人太多。此外，他命令司机加速将车开到最近的警察局。于是我将玻璃摇上，此时仍听到约20声枪响。我们乘坐的车辆随即驶入河南路。
由于射击时路上行人众多，我无法看到袭击我们车辆的人。
此为实情。

签署：王功成。

pages.en:
DU HAI SAN (涂海山).

Anhwei (Heh-vee)             // D.S.I Wong Foh Sung.
C.B.H.Q.(C.S)      17.10.38   translated    H s u.
                              ///////

My name is Du Hai san, age 50, native of Heh-Vee, Anhwei,
married, employed and residing at No. 39 Nanyang Road.
I have been employed as a valet of Mr. Zau, of above address,
for over 10 years.

At 5.20 p.m. 17.10.38 I left the office of the Consolidated
Tax Bureau of Chekiang, Anhwei and Kiangsu, together with my
master. On stepping into the car I sat on the left side of
my master and the m/car was then driven away east to Kiangse
Road, turned north towards Nanking Road and then turned west
along the last mentioned road. On arrival at a point outside
the Ha-Deong Building, Nanking Road, hearing a sudden burst
of shots, I immediately enforced my master to lie down in
the car and I then lay my own body down as well, telling
our chauffeur to speed up. I noticed one of my master's
bodyguards named Wong Keong Zung, pointing his pistol outside
through a car window. On seeing this my master at once
instructed Wong Keong Zung to pull up the glass but not
to fire any shot as there were too many pedestrians at
the time. My master further ordered the chauffeur to
rush to a nearest Police Station, when I heard a fusillade
of bullets being fired on the roadway. Our M/Car was then
speedily driven to Central Police Station via Henan and
Hankow Roads.

The above is my true statement.

SIGNED : DU HAI SAN.
pages.zh:
涂海山 (DU HAI SAN)。

安徽 (Heh-vee)             // 副督察黄福松 (D.S.I Wong Foh Sung)。
中央捕房总部 (C.S)      1938年10月17日   翻译    H s u。
                              ///////

本人姓名杜海山，年龄50岁，籍贯安徽合肥 (Heh-Vee)，已婚，受雇并居住于南阳路39号。
我在上述地址受雇于Zau（音译）先生，担任其贴身男仆已超过10年。

1938年10月17日下午5时20分，我与主人一同离开浙江、安徽及江苏三省统税局办公室。上车后，我坐在主人左侧，机动车随即向东驶往江西路，转入南京路方向向北，随后沿最后提到的道路向西行驶。当到达南京路哈同大楼（Ha-Deong Building）外某处时，听到突然的一阵枪声，我立即强令主人在车内趴下，随后我也趴下身体，并告诉司机加速。我注意到主人的一名保镖，名叫王功成 (Wong Keong Zung)，正透过车窗将手枪指向外面。见此情景，主人立即指示王功成摇上车窗，但不要开枪，因为当时行人太多。主人进一步命令司机赶往最近的警察局，此时我听到路面上一阵密集的枪声。随后我们的机动车经由河南路和汉口路迅速驶往中央捕房。

以上是我的真实陈述。

签署：杜海山。

pages.en:
FAUNG ZAU TSUNG (房兆珍)。
Yangchow. // 6.D.S.-72. D.S. Fowler
C.B.H.Q.(C.S) 17.10.38 C.D.S. 72.

My name is Faung Zau Tsung, Yangchow, M/Chauffeur
(S.M.C. permit No. 19331), working and residing No. 39
Nanyang Road.

I have worked as chauffeur for 5 years and been in my
present position for about 6 months. My employer is named
Zau Shih Chuen (即式軍), a director of the Consolidated
Tax Bureau of the Chekiang, Anhwei and Kiangsu Provinces.
He resides at No. 39 Nanyang Road has has offices at No
230 Kiukiang Road.

At about 5.30 p.m. 18.10.38 I drove M/Car S.M.C.
Lic. No. 10241 from No. 230 Kiukiang Road. Inside the
Car were three others; Chen Ming Dzien (许明芝), Tsang
Yuen Dong (張荣棠), and Wong Toong Hwei (王东辉), all
employed as bodyguards by my master. It is our duty to
follow my master's car (S.M.C. Lic. No. 10248) wherever
he goes.

My master left his home at 3.30 p.m. 17.10.38 and
I and the three bodyguards followed in my car. He proceeded
to the office at No. 230 Kiukiang Road and left there at
5.30 p.m.

Both cars proceeded east along Kiukiang Road and North
along Kiangse Road to Nanking Road where we turned west.
By this time however four, five or six other cars had come
in between my master's car and the one I was driving.

As we proceeded along Nanking Road and about 40 or 50
yards west of Kiangse Road I heard a sudden burst of shots
coming from my front. I did not know the cause or the object
pages.zh:
房兆珍 (FAUNG ZAU TSUNG)。
扬州。// 6.D.S.-72. 福勒警司 (D.S. Fowler)
中央捕房总部 (C.S) 1938年10月17日 C.D.S. 72。

本人姓名房兆珍，扬州人，机动车司机
（工部局执照编号19331），工作并居住于南阳路39号。

我从事司机工作已有5年，现任职位约6个月。我的雇主名叫Zau Shih Chuen（即式軍），是浙江、安徽及江苏三省统税局的董事。
他居住于南阳路39号，办公室位于九江路230号。

1938年10月18日下午5时30分左右，我驾驶工部局牌照号为10241的机动车从九江路230号出发。车内另有三人；陈明芝 (Chen Ming Dzien)（许明芝），张荣棠 (Tsang Yuen Dong)（張荣棠），和王东辉 (Wong Toong Hwei)（王东辉），均受雇为我主人的保镖。我们的职责是无论主人去哪里，都要跟随他的车（工部局牌照号10248）。

我的主人于1938年10月17日下午3时30分离家，我和三名保镖乘坐我的车跟随。他前往九江路230号的办公室，并于下午5时30分离开那里。

两辆车均沿九江路向东行驶，沿江西路向北至南京路，随后我们向西转弯。
但此时，已有四、五或六辆其他车辆插入我主人的车和我驾驶的车之间。

当我们沿南京路行驶，距江西路西约40或50码时，我听到前方突然传来一阵枪声。我不知道枪声的原因或目标

pages.en:
- 2 -
of the shots but saw my master's car increase speed and
then turn south down Henan Road and proceed to Central
Police Station.
On arrival there, I learned that my master's car
was the object of the attack.
I did not see any of the attackers. The route
taken to and from office is that of my master's choosing.

SIGNED : FAUNG ZAU TSUNG.
pages.zh:
- 2 -
但我看到我主人的车加速，然后向南转入河南路，并前往中央捕房。
到达那里后，我得知我主人的车是袭击的目标。
我没有看到任何袭击者。往返办公室的路线是由我主人选择的。

签署：房兆珍。

pages.en:
TSANG YUEN DONG (修荣棠).
SHANTUNG.. // C.D.S. 72.
C.R.H.Q. (C.S) 17.10.38 HSU.

My name is Tsang Yuen Dong, age 28, native of Shantung,
m/bodyguard, employed and residing 39 Nanyang Road.
I was formerly a C.P.C. of the Nantao Police for about
4 years and I left this position after the recent Shanghai
hostilities on 13.8.37. In October 1937 I removed to live
in the International Settlement.
Some time during March 1938 a friend of mine, named
Du Hai San introduced me to work as a bodyguard at No.39
Nanyang Road, the residence of one named Zam.
At 3.30 p.m. on 17.10.38 I left the above address
together with Fang Zam Tsung (房兆珍) (Chauffeur),
Chen Ming Daion (陳明先) and Wong Toong Hwei (王东辉),
bodyguards, in M/Car Lic. No. 10241, and followed another
car which conveyed our master, to the latter's office at
No. 230 Kiukiang Road. On arrival at the above said address
the car was stopped and parked outside 230 Kiukiang Road.
At 5.30 p.m. even date our master came down from his
office and boarded his m/car, which was then driven out
along Kiukiang Road, turned north into Kiangsu Road and
then turned west into Nanking Road when I heard a sudden
burst of shots in front of our m/car. I then told the
chauffeur to overtake 4 or 5 m/cars proceeding in front
of ours in order to see what had happened to our master's
car which was proceeding ahead. I then saw our master's
car turn south into Henan Road and proceed to Central Police
Station where on alighting from our car I noticed over 10
bullet holes on our master's car.

This is a truth. SIGNED : TSANG YUEN DONG.
pages.zh:
修荣棠 (TSANG YUEN DONG)。
山东.. // C.D.S. 72。
中央捕房总部 (C.S) 1938年10月17日 HSU。

本人姓名修荣棠，年龄28岁，籍贯山东，机动车保镖，受雇并居住于南阳路39号。
我曾任南市警察巡长（C.P.C.）约4年，在1937年8月13日最近的上海战事爆发后，我于1937年10月离职。1937年10月，我搬入公共租界居住。
1938年3月的某个时候，我的一位名叫杜海山的朋友介绍我到南阳路39号担任保镖，那是名为Zam（音译）的人的住所。
1938年10月17日下午3时30分，我与方兆珍 (Fang Zam Tsung)（房兆珍）（司机）、陈明先 (Chen Ming Daion)（陳明先）和王东辉 (Wong Toong Hwei)（王东辉）等保镖一起，乘坐牌照号为10241的机动车离开上述地址，跟随载有我们主人的另一辆车，前往后者位于九江路230号的办公室。到达上述地址后，车辆停下并停泊在九江路230号外。
同日（even date）下午5时30分，我们的主人从办公室下来，登上他的机动车，该车随即沿九江路驶出，转入江苏路（Kiangsu Road）向北，随后转入南京路向西，此时我听到我们机动车前方突然传来一阵枪声。我随即告诉司机超越前方行驶的四五辆机动车，以便查看走在前面的主人车辆发生了什么事。随后我看到主人的车向南转入河南路，并前往中央捕房，当我们下车时，我注意到主人的车上有超过10个弹孔。

此为实情。签署：修荣棠。

pages.en:
CHEN MING DZIEN (陳明先)

Anhwei                                // C.D.S. 72.

C.B.H.Q. (C.8)          17.10.38                          IBU.

My name is Chen Ming Dzien, age 28, native of Anhwei,
M/bodyguard, employed and residing at No. 39 Nanyang Road.
    I was formerly a C.P.C. of the Nantao Police, but
lost the position and removed to live in the Settlement
in October 1937 after the outbreak of the recent Shanghai
hostilities on 13.8.37.
    In Feb. 1938 a friend of mine named Zee Pao Ziang
introduced me to Zan Shih Choen, Chief of the Consolidated
Tax Bureau of Chekiang, Anhwei and Kiangsu Provinces, to
act as the latter's bodyguard.
    At 3.30 p.m. on 17.10.38 I left No. 39 Nanyang Road
together with Faung Zan Tsang (房兆珍), chauffeur, Wong
Teong Huel and Tsang Yuen Dong, bodyguards, in m/car Lic.
No. 10641 and followed our master to his office at No. 230
Kinkiang Road. At 5.30 p.m. same date our master left his
office and returned home in his private m/car, whilst we
followed him in another car. Our cars were driven along
Kinkiang Road east to west, turned north into Kiangsu Road,
and then turned west into Nanking Road, when I heard the
firing of pistolshots. We then told our chauffeur to
speedily drive our m/car and seeing our master's car turning
south into Honan Road, we followed him from behind. Eventually
Finally we all stopped at the Central Police Station where, on
alighting from the car I saw our master's car bearing in the
rear approximately 18 holes caused by bullets.
    The above is my true statement.

                        SIGNED : CHEN MING DZIEN.
pages.zh:
陳明先 (CHEN MING DZIEN)

安徽                                // C.D.S. 72。

中央捕房总部 (C.8)          1938年10月17日                          IBU。

本人姓名陈明先，年龄28岁，籍贯安徽，机动车保镖，受雇并居住于南阳路39号。
    我曾任南市警察巡长（C.P.C.），但在1937年8月13日最近的上海战事爆发后，我失去了该职位，并于1937年10月搬入租界居住。
    1938年2月，我的一位名叫Zee Pao Ziang（音译）的朋友将我介绍给浙江、安徽及江苏三省统税局局长Zan Shih Choen（音译），担任其保镖。
    1938年10月17日下午3时30分，我与司机房兆珍 (Faung Zan Tsang)（房兆珍）、保镖王东辉 (Wong Teong Huel) 和修荣棠 (Tsang Yuen Dong) 一起，乘坐牌照号为10641的机动车离开南阳路39号，跟随主人前往其位于金江路（Kinkiang Road，原文如此，应为九江路 Kiukiang Road）230号的办公室。同日（same date）下午5时30分，我们的主人离开办公室，乘坐其私人机动车回家，而我们则乘坐另一辆车跟随。我们的车沿金江路（Kinkiang Road）由东向西行驶，转入江苏路（Kiangsu Road）向北，随后转入南京路向西，此时我听到手枪射击声。我们随即告诉司机加速驾驶我们的机动车，看到主人的车向南转入河南路，我们从后方跟随。最终（Eventually Finally）我们都在中央捕房停下，下车后，我看到主人的车尾部有约18个弹孔。
    以上是我的真实陈述。

                        签署：陈明先。

pages.en:
GORDON GORDON.
BRITISH                                     D.S.I. CRIGHTON
C.S.                17.10.38                --"--

My name is Gordon Gordon, age 43, British Subject,
photographer, with offices at 221 Nanking Road and residing
at 379 Haiphong Road.
    Shortly after 5 p.m. 17.10.38, whilst I was standing
at the window of my studio, which is located over the
Chocolate Shop, Nanking Road and faces direct west along
Nanking Road, I heard a sharp report, which I at first
took to be the bursting of a ricksha or m/car type, however
as it was immediately followed by several other similar
reports I looked onto Nanking Road, where I observed pedes-
trians scattering in every direction, and simultaneously
saw two male Chinese, one dressed in dark coloured foreign
clothes and the other in light blue short jacket and pants
both armed with what appeared to be automatic pistols, standin
about 30 ft west of the Chocolate Shop, on the roadway, betwee
the Traffic Island and the m/car park on Nanking Road, firing
in a westerly direction towards a large dark blue m/car which
was proceeding slowly west towards Nanking Road. I further
observed the man in foreign dress running in a westerly
direction towards the m/car, whilst the man dressed in
light blue short jacket and pants kept walking backwards
apparently firing into the air. When the latter had appa-
rently exhausted his ammunition he calmly placed the pistol
into the top of his pants and walked east towards Kiangse
Road. At this time I obtained a full view of his face and
can easily identify him if I should see him again. After having
seen the aforegoing which only covered a few seconds, I
pages.zh:
戈登·戈登。
英国籍                                     D.S.I. 克里顿
C.S.                1938年10月17日        ——同上——

本人名为戈登·戈登，43岁，英国臣民，
摄影师，办公地点位于南京路221号，居住于
海防路379号。
    1938年10月17日下午5点刚过，当我站在
我的工作室窗前时，该工作室位于巧克力店楼上，
沿南京路朝正西方向，我听到一声清脆的枪响，起初
我以为是人包车或汽车轮胎爆裂的声音，然而，
由于紧接着又传来几声类似的响声，我便向南京路上
张望，只见行人四处逃散，同时我看到两名中国男子，
一人身穿深色西式服装，另一人身穿浅蓝色短夹克和长裤，
两人均持有看似自动手枪的武器，站在
巧克力店以西约30英尺处的路面上，介于
交通岛与南京路上的汽车停车场之间，正向一辆缓慢向西
行驶的大型深蓝色汽车开火。我还观察到那名身穿
西式服装的男子向西朝那辆汽车跑去，而身穿
浅蓝色短夹克和长裤的男子则一边后退一边
显然向空中射击。当后者似乎打光了子弹后，他冷静地将手枪
塞入裤腰，向东朝江西路走去。此时我看清了他的全脸，
如果再次见到他，我能轻易认出。在目睹了上述
仅持续几秒钟的情景后，我

pages.en:
- 2 -

immediately dashed downstairs, with a view to apprehending
the man in the light blue short jacket and pants, however,
on arriving at a point near the Power Co. offices, I observed
three such dressed persons. Not being sure which was which
as they all had their backs to me, I approached a C.P.C.
who was then standing on the south side of Nanking Road
near the Power Co., and requested him to arrest the two
men who were walking just in front of him. Apparently he
did not understand me for he made no move, and as the third
had by this time crossed Nanking Road towards Kiangse Road
(North side) I gave chase to him and at the corner of Kiangse
Road I saw him just a few feet in front of me. I then called
to another C.P.C. whom I met at this corner and he together
with a foreign officer who had come on the scene effected
his arrest, however after I had seen this man's face I knew
I had made a mistake and told the foreign officer so. I
then retraced my steps to the south side of Nanking Road,
but being unable to locate the other two I returned to
the Liao Koh Fook Silk Store where I joined S.I. Lee's and
F.S. Fallace. Together we searched the premises but I
could see no one who resembled the Chinese dressed or foreign
dress. I cannot definitely identify this man as I only saw
his back and never once caught a glimpse of his face.

Later I was brought to Central Police Station where
I related the aforegoing in addition to which I gave the
following description of the persons responsible for the
offence.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

立即冲下楼，意图逮捕那名身穿浅蓝色短夹克和长裤的男子，然而，
当我到达电力公司办公室附近时，我看到三名穿着类似的人。
由于他们都背对着我，我无法确定哪一个是目标，于是我走近一名
当时站在南京路南侧、电力公司附近的华捕（C.P.C.），
请求他逮捕就在他前方行走的那两名男子。显然他
没有理解我的意思，因为他没有任何行动，而此时第三人
已穿过南京路朝江西路（北侧）走去，我便追赶此人，
在江西路口，我看到他就在我前方几英尺处。随后我向
在该路口遇到的另一名华捕呼喊，他与一名赶到现场的
外籍警官一起将其逮捕，然而，当我看清此人的脸后，我知道
我抓错了人，并告知了那名外籍警官。
随后我折返至南京路南侧，但因无法找到另外两人，
便回到老介福绸缎局，与李巡官（S.I. Lee）和
法警福莱斯（F.S. Fallace）会合。我们一起搜查了该场所，但我
未见到任何穿着中式或西式服装且相貌相似的人。我无法确切指认此人，因为我仅看到
他的背影，从未瞥见他的脸。

后来我被带到中央捕房，在那里我陈述了上述情况，此外还提供了
以下关于作案人员的描述。

pages.en:
Central Station.
17-10-38

Re shooting affray on Nanking Road.
S.I. Stocks

Sir,
    I beg to report that at about 5-30 p.m. 17-10-38, I was
assisting in regulating traffic at Nanking Road Kiangse Road
crossing when my attention was attracted by an Italian Military
dispatch rider acting rather unusual with his machine. The
dispatch rider was proceeding West to East along Nanking Road
when, nearing Kiangse Road he suddenly turned round in crowded
traffic and proceeded West. A few seconds later the dispatch
rider re-appeared travelling from From West To East and turned
North into Kiangse Road. At this time a foreigner in shirt
sleeves came running west to east along Nanking Road and also
turned north into Kiangse Road beckoning to me as he ran.
    I caught up with the foreigner who explained that a
shooting affray had occurred outside his offices on Nanking Road
and **〔此处转录不清〕** that he believed one armed man had escaped
along Kiangse Road. The Italian dispatch rider had apparently
witnessed something of the shooting and was attempting to assist
police by riding up and down Kiangse Road in an effort to identify
the escaping gunman. With the help of several C.P.C's who had
followed me , I conducted a search party along Kiangse Road and
west along Tientsin Road, and arrested a male Chinese whom the above
foreigner stated looked like one of the armed men. My party then
returned to the scene of the shooting, Nanking Road and Honan Road
corner and, with F.S. Fallace generally assisted in searching
pedestrians and the Lou Bao Foh Silk Store, No.257 Nanking Road. A
party of Police arrived from the station and the suspect was
handed over to detectives. I did not hear the sound of shooting
from where I was standing owing to the facts that, at the time a
heavy stream of traffic was proceeding west, coupled with the
noise of the Italian dispatch rider's machine would shut out the
report of a pistol before anything came.
pages.zh:
中央捕房。
1938年10月17日

关于南京路枪击事件。
斯托克斯巡官（S.I. Stocks）

先生，
    谨报告，1938年10月17日下午5点30分左右，我正在
南京路与江西路交叉口协助指挥交通，此时一名意大利军用
摩托车传令兵因其机车行为异常引起了我的注意。该传令兵
正沿南京路由西向东行驶，当接近江西路时，他在拥挤的
车流中突然掉头向西行驶。几秒钟后，该传令兵再次出现，
由西向东行驶，并转入江西路向北行驶。此时，一名只穿衬衫
袖子（注：意指未穿外套）的外国人沿南京路由西向东奔跑，
并在跑动中向我招手示意，随后也转入江西路向北。
    我追上了这名外国人，他解释说在他的南京路办公室外发生了一起
枪击事件，**〔此处转录不清〕** 他认为一名持械男子已沿
江西路逃脱。这名意大利传令兵显然目睹了部分枪击过程，
并试图通过在江西路上来回骑行来协助警方识别
逃逸的枪手。在几名跟随我的华捕（C.P.C.s）的帮助下，
我带领搜查队沿江西路及向西沿天津路进行搜索，并逮捕了一名中国男子，上述
外国人称其看起来像其中一名持械者。随后我的小队返回
枪击现场，即南京路与河南路交叉口，并与法警福莱斯（F.S. Fallace）一起协助搜查
行人及南京路257号的老宝丰（Lou Bao Foh）绸缎局。一队
警察从捕房赶到，嫌疑人被移交给探员。由于当时有大量
车流向西行驶，加上意大利传令兵机车的噪音，掩盖了
手枪的声响，因此我在站立位置并未听到枪声。

C.P.C. 3275.
Central Station           17-10-38            self.

At about 5-20 p.m. on the 17-10-38 whilst
standing at Nanking and Kiangse, I saw a foreigner speaking
to the Foreign Inspector about a shooting case. I immediately
accompanied the Foreign Inspector and ran to Tientsin Road. At
that time I saw a young male Chinese walking from South to
North on Kiangse Road. I immediately went up and effected his
arrest. As I was standing at Nanking near Kiangse Roads I
did not see or hear the shooting which had taken place.
This is my true statement.

Signed.
pages.zh:
华捕 3275号。
中央捕房           1938年10月17日            自述。

1938年10月17日下午5点20分左右，当我
站在南京路与江西路口时，我看到一名外国人正在
向一名外籍巡长谈论一起枪击案。我立即
陪同该外籍巡长跑向天津路。当时我看到一名年轻中国男子
在江西路上由南向北行走。我立即上前将其
逮捕。由于我当时站在南京路靠近江西路的地方，
我并未看到或听到发生的枪击。
这是我的真实陈述。

签名。

pages.en:
Havildar 521 Kishan Singh.
S.P.C. 186.
Central Station 17-10-38

At 5-20 p.m. on October 17-th 1938, I was on
traffic duty at Nanking Road and Honan Road corner assisting
S.P.C. 245 who was in charge of the signal switch to control the
traffic. At the time the South and North bound traffic on Honan
Road had the right of way. I was standing on the South side of
Nanking Road facing West, watching cyclists and ricshas.

I heard some shots fired behind me, so took my
revolver from the holster, turned around and immediately 〔此处转录不清〕/
dashed towards the sound of the firing. Many Chinese were
dashing around in all directions but I did not see any person
shooting or in possession of a firearm.

I thought that the person responsible for the
shooting might have run into the large silk store at Nanking Roa
and Honan Road corner so I posted myself at the door to prevent
any person leaving.

Shortly afterwards Foreign Sergeant No.71 in
plain clothes arrived and ordered me to remain on duty at the
door. I had seen the Foreigner ask S.P.C. 245 for his revolver
and recognising the foreigner was attached to Central Station
I told the constable to let him have the weapon.

Later , I instructed S.P.C. 245 to telephone
the station and was informed that he had already told a C.P.C.
to do so. Shortly afterwards some Foreign and Chinese police
and detectives arrived in the red motorcar . I later returned to
control traffic.

Signed.
pages.zh:
印籍巡长 521号 基尚·辛格（Kishan Singh）。
特别巡捕 186号。
中央捕房 1938年10月17日

1938年10月17日下午5点20分，我正在
南京路与河南路交叉口执行交通勤务，协助负责控制交通
信号开关的特别巡捕 245号。当时河南路南北向
车辆拥有通行权。我站在南京路南侧，面朝西，观察
骑自行车者和人力车。

我听到身后传来几声枪响，于是从枪套中取出
左轮手枪，转身并立即〔此处转录不清〕/
朝枪声方向冲去。许多中国人四处奔逃，但我未看到任何
开枪或持有枪支的人。

我认为开枪责任人可能已跑进南京路与
河南路路口的大型绸缎店，因此我守在门口以防
任何人离开。

不久后，便衣外籍巡长71号赶到，命令我继续在门口
执勤。我看到该外国人向特别巡捕 245号索要左轮手枪，
因认出该外国人隶属于中央捕房，我便告诉该巡捕
将武器交给他。

随后，我指示特别巡捕 245号打电话回捕房，
得知他已让一名华捕去做此事。不久后，一些外籍和华人警察
及探员乘坐红色汽车抵达。随后我返回
继续指挥交通。

签名。

pages.en:
S.P.C. 245 Pram Singh.
Central Station 17-10-38 S.P.C. 186.

At 5-20 p.m. 17-10-38 I was on traffic duty at
Nanking Road and Honan Road corner. I was operating the
light switch and had given right of way to North and South
bound traffic, along Honan Road.

At this time I heard the sound of shooting on
Nanking Road to the East of Honan Road. Upon hearing the
firing I took the revolver from my holster and, leaving the
traffic post, proceeded in the direction of the shooting.
However, a large crowd of Chinese were decamping from the
vicinity and I could not locate the person responsible for
the shooting.

The East and West bound traffic on Nanking Road
was held up by the red light, and a large number of motor cars
and other vehicles were congregated in the vicinity. I did
not see any shooting from or at a motor car.

I decided to return to the traffic post and
resume control of the traffic. I then met Foreign Sergeant
No.71 who was in civilian dress and he ordered me to give him
my revolver. I knew the foreigner was attached to Central
Station and Havildar No.521 told me to let him have the weapon.

I then saw C.P.C. 3096 and informed him to
telephone the station regarding the shooting.

I returned to my post and shortly afterwards
a party of police arrived from the station.

Later, the foreign sergeant returned the
revolver to me.

Signed.
pages.zh:
特别巡捕 245号 普拉姆·辛格（Pram Singh）。
中央捕房 1938年10月17日 特别巡捕 186号。

1938年10月17日下午5点20分，我正在
南京路与河南路交叉口执行交通勤务。我正在操作
信号灯开关，并已给予河南路南北向
车辆通行权。

此时，我听到河南路以东的南京路上传来
枪声。听到枪声后，我从枪套中取出左轮手枪，离开
交通岗位，朝枪声方向前进。
然而，大量中国人正从附近逃离，我无法找到
开枪责任人。

南京路东西向交通因红灯受阻，大量汽车
和其他车辆聚集在附近。我未看到有任何从汽车内射出
或射向汽车的枪击。

我决定返回交通岗位并恢复对交通的
控制。随后我遇到了身着便服的外籍巡长71号，他命令我将
左轮手枪交给他。我知道该外国人隶属于中央
捕房，且印籍巡长521号告诉我让他拿走武器。

随后我看到华捕 3096号，并通知他
就枪击事件打电话回捕房。

我返回岗位，不久后
一队警察从捕房赶到。

后来，该外籍巡长将
左轮手枪还给了我。

签名。

pages.en:
Central
17-10-38

Shooting on Nanking Road, East of Honan Road.

Inspector Lees.

Sir,
    At 5.20p.m. on the 17/10/38 the undersigned was sitting
in the Chocolate Shop, Nanking Road (rear room ) having tea,
when my wife, who is the Manageress of said shop, came and
told me that some shooting had taken place on Nanking Road
near the corner of Honan Road.
    I ran out, and on the corner of Nanking and Honan Roads
I saw a squad of Police surrounding the Laou Kai Fook Silk
Store, situated on Nanking Road and Honan Road, the C.P.C's
told me that an attempted assassination had taken place outside
and that the assassins were inside, no police had attempted
to enter, so the undersigned being off duty borrowed a C.P.C's
pistol and proceeded inside and questioned the employees and
customers, but they informed me that the assassins had not
entered that shop, I then went outside the shop, and ascertained
that the shooting had taken place on the South side of Nanking
Road, East of Honan Road, I searched in the location pointed
out to me and found two shell cases, which I handed over to
D.I. Telfer who had arrived on the scene.

                                I am, Sir,
                                your obedient servant,

〔此处转录不清：左侧签名〕

                                Inspector.
                                〔此处转录不清：右侧签名〕

D.O."A" Div.
pages.zh:
中央捕房
1938年10月17日

河南路以东南京路枪击事件。

李斯巡官（Inspector Lees）。

先生，
    1938年10月17日下午5点20分，署名者正坐在
南京路巧克力店（后室）喝茶，此时我的妻子，即该店
经理，前来告知我，河南路路口附近的南京路上发生了
枪击事件。
    我跑出去，在南京路与河南路的交叉口，
我看到一队警察包围了位于南京路与河南路口的
老介福（Laou Kai Fook）绸缎局，华捕们告诉我，外面发生了一起
未遂刺杀事件，刺客在店内，尚无警察尝试
进入，因此署名者作为下班人员，借了一名华捕的
手枪进入店内，询问员工和顾客，但他们告知我刺客并未
进入该店，随后我走出店外，确认
枪击发生在南京路南侧，河南路以东，我在被指出的
地点进行搜索，发现了两个弹壳，并将其交给了
已抵达现场的特尔弗探员（D.I. Telfer）。

                                此致，
                                您顺从的仆人，

〔此处转录不清：左侧签名〕

                                巡官。
                                〔此处转录不清：右侧签名〕

“A”分区值班警官。
